_readme: Real, screenshot-verified system economy/race/conflict samples for the NMS Galactic Map project.
Purpose: ground truth to eventually fit/verify the race, economy-tier, conflict-tier, and buy/sell%
formulas in nms-core/economy.js (currently invented flavour logic, per that file's own header).
Source: screenshots shared by a friend via Google Drive (folder id 1X0qOa-szluKahnY9DlE_1CS741mYAAlj,
owner ggfsfvids@gmail.com), collected in-game 2026-07-21. Player: 'GoodGuysFree, the Seeker'.
Of 14 screenshots actually present in that shared folder as of 2026-08-23 (user described ~70 --
only 14 were visible/synced from this end, see conversation), only 2 show the full galaxy-starmap
info panel (name/region/distance/star class/race/economy/conflict/buy-sell%). The other 12 are
per-planet Discoveries screens (no economy text, just unlabelled hex-badge icons) or unrelated
photo-mode shots -- not usable for this corpus as-is.
No portal address (galactic coordinates) is visible in these screenshots, so these records can't
yet be tied to a specific 12-hex portal code / seed. They ARE usable to check the real vocabulary
and value ranges (tier names, sell/buy% bounds) against nms-core/economy.js's ECON_S/CONFLICT word
pools and its 0.45/0.85 and 0.45/0.82 tier-threshold guesses.

2026-08-23 update: added 'records_with_address' -- 11 real records pulled from Tony's own overrides.json ('Edit System' submissions on the live site), each with its real 12-hex portal address + galaxy, unlike the two screenshot-derived 'records' above which have no address. 4 of these 11 are fully complete (race, economy type+tier, sell%, buy%, conflict, star class, region); the other 7 only have race/economy-type/conflict -- the site's Edit System form appears to have started capturing econDesc/sell/buy/starClass/region partway through (all complete records are dated 2026-08-17 or later; all partial ones are dated 2026-08-06 to 2026-08-09). Every one of the 4 complete records -- and both screenshot records -- is a yellow (F/G-class) star; there is currently zero real data for red, green, blue, or purple systems anywhere in this corpus.

records.notes: Umensk-Feks XVIII's own visited-systems list entry shows a yellow star dot, consistent with F-class = yellow.

Also shows a yellow star dot in the visited-systems sidebar. Two yellow (F-class) systems with two different races (Vy'keen vs Gek) already rules out any simple 1:1 star-colour -> race mapping -- consistent with economy.js treating race as an independent roll, and with the NMS wiki's own statement that economy type/strength/modifiers are independent of faction.

cross_checks_against_existing_economy_js: 'Unsuccessful' is in ECON_S[0] (low tier) -- matches, tier 0 confirmed real vocabulary.
'Medium Supply' is in ECON_S[1] (mid tier) -- matches, tier 1 confirmed real vocabulary.
'Mercantile' is in ECON[0]'s name pool for the 'Trading' economy type -- matches.
'Scientific' is both the ECON type name and in its own name pool -- matches.
Sell% 49.8 and 59.1 both fall in economy.js's tier-1/tier-2 formula ranges (30-60 / 55-80) loosely,
though with only 2 points this is not yet a real statistical check -- just a sanity spot-check.
Buy% -11.1 and -18.6 are both within economy.js's flat -(5 to 30)% guess band.
